cohort: Women in Denmark with two deliveries, the first being a cesarean section and the second an uncomplicated, term delivery
finding: While women with a TOLAC had an increased odds of neonatal death compared to ERCS, this association decreased over time and was likely due to other healthcare improvements.
mod_finding: Women with a trial of labor after caesarean (TOLAC) had an increased odds of neonatal death compared to women with an elective repeat CS (ERCS).
